grandparents_cupboard.reason: Tinned chickpeas, flour, tahini, oil and fresh vegetables are all plain whole foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every item, including tahini and little gem lettuces, is an everyday Tesco purchase.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a pan, a frying pan and a masher, and shaping and frying patties is well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: Two tins of chickpeas bound with flour make eight sensible patties, and with 750g potatoes, salad and a lemony tahini dressing that is a well-seasoned dinner for four.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes is fair for slicing, mashing, shaping and whisking the dressing, and the frying fits inside the 15 to 20 minutes the potatoes take to boil.

honest_ingredients.reason: Little gem is a lettuce, and every listed ingredient and seasoning, including parsley, lemon and cumin, is used in the steps.

seasonal_feel.reason: Crisp little gem cups with radish and cucumber make a light, fresh plate that suits early May, and the lettuce is named in the title and shapes the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no fuss or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Chickpea patties with potatoes and fresh salad make a filling, balanced family meal.
